stops.name: Hazeltop
stops.description: Sedimentary rock core from the Wildcat Ridge member of the Jezero delta front; drilled and sealed by Perseverance.
stops.geology: Fine-grained delta-front sedimentary rock with sulfate and clay-bearing signals, sampled to study ancient lake chemistry.

provenance.site: Wildcat Ridge, Delta Front, Jezero Crater
provenance.citation: NASA Science, Mars Rock Samples, sample 12 (Hazeltop), sol 509; accessed 2026-11-13.
provenance.note: xy is a local synthetic-grid position; latitude/longitude is approximate contextual provenance, not a surveyed fix.

stops.name: Montdenier
stops.description: Igneous rock core from the Rochette outcrop at Artuby Ridge, one of the first two cores cached by Perseverance.
stops.geology: Olivine-bearing basaltic lava-flow rock, sampled to date Jezero floor volcanism and assess aqueous alteration.

provenance.citation: NASA Science, Mars Rock Samples, sample 2 (Montdenier), sol 194; accessed 2026-11-13.
provenance.note: xy is a local synthetic-grid position; latitude/longitude is approximate contextual provenance, not a surveyed fix.

stops.name: Mageik
stops.description: Sedimentary rock core from the Amalik member of the delta front, sealed during the 2022 delta campaign.
stops.geology: Delta-front mudstone/sandstone package used to reconstruct fluvial-lacustrine depositional conditions.

provenance.citation: NASA Science, Mars Rock Samples, sample 15 (Mageik), sol 619; accessed 2026-11-13.
provenance.note: xy is a local synthetic-grid position; latitude/longitude is approximate contextual provenance, not a surveyed fix.
